name: @guardbee/mcp-toxic-flow-auditor
description: MCP server that detects toxic flows (lethal trifecta) across an MCP tool catalog — untrusted content + private/sensitive data + exfiltration or destruction on the same server
long_description: Audits an MCP server's tools/list (or source .tool registrations) for Simon Willison's lethal trifecta: the combination of untrusted content, sensitive/private data, and an exfiltration or destruction path on one server. A prompt injection can chain those capabilities. Reports A–F grades and dangerous pairs (sensitive+exfil, untrusted+exfil, sensitive+destruct). Includes KVKK-aware PII heuristics. Mapped to OWASP MCP10:2025. No API key — local static/catalog analysis only.
